Title: We are retiring Classic Azure Migrate on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
As Azure Migrate has evolved into an integrated hub of tools for you to discover, assess and migrate on-premises and cloud workloads to Azure, we retire the Classic Azure Migrate on 29 February 2024. The new version of Azure Migrate is available since Jul 2019 and we encourage you to make the switch early to gain the richer benefits of Azure Migrate. 

Action required

Follow the steps to update your workload to Azure Migrate before 29 February 2024. After 29 February 2024, the Classic Azure Migrate will no longer be supported and the inventory metadata in the project created under this service will be deleted.

More information

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
